test.create_query: CREATE TABLE volume_reducing_functions (key UInt64, s String, fs FixedString(64)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO volume_reducing_functions SELECT number, randomPrintableASCII(100), randomPrintableASCII(64) FROM numbers(10000000)
